verdict.rationale: Probes show no llms.txt (HTTP 404). However, a raw markdown/MDX variant of the docs is served at /docs/.md, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is available at /openapi.json, so an agent can still ingest some docs. The .md output is unrendered Astro/Starlight MDX source with component imports, not a curated agent-oriented format. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, clean agent-oriented markdown docs, first-party documentation of agent-readable docs, and hands-on corroboration.
